checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is block RLP size validated before any processing occurs (EIP-7934)?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Identify the entry point where blocks are received from P2P network. 2. Verify that len(rlp.encode(block)) > MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE check occurs BEFORE any RLP decoding or block header parsing. 3. Craft a block payload exceeding MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE and verify rejection at the network layer. 4. Confirm that oversized blocks do not trigger resource-intensive operations before rejection.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-1, Trust Boundary: tb-010. EIP-7934 specific defense. A P2P peer can send arbitrarily large block payloads.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are blocks with non-empty ommers rejected in post-merge Ethereum?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Create a block with block.ommers set to a non-empty tuple. 2. Submit block via P2P network. 3. Verify that state_transition rejects the block with an appropriate error. 4. Verify that validate_header also enforces this constraint (defense-in-depth).
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-2, Trust Boundary: tb-005. Post-merge invariant. Non-empty ommers could trigger pre-merge code paths.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Do all 8 computed roots/hashes match header values after block execution?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. For each of the 8 fields (gas_used, transactions_root, state_root, receipt_root, bloom, withdrawals_root, blob_gas_used, requests_hash), create a block with a mismatched computed vs header value. 2. Verify that state_transition rejects each case.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-3, Trust Boundaries: tb-002, tb-005. Bypass allows invalid state transitions leading to consensus failure.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is transaction sender identity correctly derived from ECDSA signature?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify recover_sender correctly implements ECDSA recovery from (v, r, s) signature. 2. Test with malleable signatures (high-s values) and verify rejection per EIP-2.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-5, Trust Boundary: tb-001. Signature spoofing allows account takeover.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is RLP encoding deterministic and collision-free?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Test RLP encoding with various block structures and verify determinism.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-6, Trust Boundaries: tb-002, tb-005, tb-010. Non-deterministic encoding causes consensus splits.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is keccak256 collision-resistant and correctly implemented?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify keccak256 implementation produces correct test vectors.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-7, Trust Boundaries: tb-002, tb-005. Implementation bug in hash computation could enable block forgery.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is withdrawal amount scaled correctly by 10^9 (Gwei to Wei)?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Trace the process_withdrawals function to verify the scaling factor of 10^9. 2. Test with withdrawal amounts at boundary values.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-8, Trust Boundaries: tb-003, tb-007. Incorrect scaling affects total ETH supply.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does withdrawal processing only increase balances, never decrease?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Review process_withdrawals implementation for any subtraction operations.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-9, Trust Boundary: tb-007. Balance decrease during withdrawal is fund loss.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Do system contracts contain code before checked system transactions execute?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify process_checked_system_transaction checks len(system_contract_code) > 0.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-10, Trust Boundary: tb-004. Missing system contract code causes block processing failure.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are checked system transaction errors propagated as InvalidBlock?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify process_checked_system_transaction raises InvalidBlock if system_tx_output.error is not None.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-11, Trust Boundaries: tb-004, tb-011. If system contract reverts on every block, chain halts.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are unchecked system transactions only used for beacon roots and history storage?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify that process_unchecked_system_transaction is only called for BEACON_ROOTS_ADDRESS and HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-12, Trust Boundary: tb-004. Unchecked variants allow silent failures for non-critical operations.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Do all blob versioned hashes have 0x01 version prefix?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit blob transaction with versioned hashes having non-0x01 prefix (e.g., 0x00, 0x02).
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-15, Trust Boundary: tb-008. Non-KZG versioned hash breaks data availability guarantees.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is gas refund capped at gas_used // 5 (EIP-3529)?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Craft transaction with operations generating large refund counters.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-16, Trust Boundary: tb-006. Excess refunds enable spam at reduced cost.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-7623 calldata floor gas cost enforced after refund?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Craft transaction with large calldata and refund-generating operations.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-17, Trust Boundary: tb-006. Bypassing floor allows cheap data availability exploitation.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are post-merge header fields (difficulty, nonce, ommers_hash) correctly zeroed?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Create block with non-zero difficulty, non-zero nonce, or non-EMPTY_OMMER_HASH ommers_hash.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-18, Trust Boundary: tb-005. Non-zero post-merge fields could trigger pre-merge code paths.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are sender accounts with code validated for EIP-7702 delegation designations?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit transaction from account with code that is NOT a valid delegation designation.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-19, Trust Boundary: tb-009. Bypass allows unauthorized code execution over victim accounts.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is transaction gas checked against remaining block gas?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit transaction with tx.gas > (block_gas_limit - block_gas_used).
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-21, Trust Boundary: tb-001. Bypass causes block gas limit overrun and consensus failure.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is transaction blob gas checked against remaining block blob gas?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit blob transaction with calculate_total_blob_gas(tx) > blob_gas_available.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-22, Trust Boundaries: tb-001, tb-008. Bypass allows excess blob data breaking data availability assumptions.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is max_fee_per_gas >= max_priority_fee_per_gas enforced for EIP-1559 transactions?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit EIP-1559 transaction with max_priority_fee_per_gas > max_fee_per_gas.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-23, Trust Boundary: tb-001. Inconsistent fee structure could cause underflow.

checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-24, Trust Boundary: tb-001. Acceptance allows under-priced execution.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Do blob transactions have between 1 and BLOB_COUNT_LIMIT blobs?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit blob transaction with 0 blobs. 2. Submit blob transaction with > MAX_BLOB_COUNT blobs.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-25, Trust Boundary: tb-008. Zero blobs wastes capacity; excess breaks data availability.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are blob and SetCode transactions prevented from creating contracts?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit blob transaction with tx.to = None. 2. Submit SetCode transaction with tx.to = None.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-26, Trust Boundaries: tb-001, tb-008, tb-009. Allowing contract creation violates EIP semantics.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Do SetCode transactions require non-empty authorization lists?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit SetCode transaction with empty authorization list.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-27, Trust Boundary: tb-009. Empty list is semantically invalid.

checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-28, Trust Boundaries: tb-001, tb-006. Nonce bypass enables replay or ordering attacks.

checklist_item.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is sender balance sufficient for maximum possible transaction cost?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify balance check: sender_balance >= (tx.gas * max_fee_per_gas) + tx.value + (blob_gas * max_fee_per_blob_gas).
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-29, Trust Boundaries: tb-001, tb-006. Bypass creates ETH from nothing -- critical fund loss.

checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-30, Trust Boundaries: tb-001, tb-006. Late nonce increment enables reentrancy attacks.

checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-35, Trust Boundary: tb-004. Incorrect ordering causes beacon root unavailability.

checklist_item.title: Does history storage system transaction execute as second operation?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify apply_body calls process_unchecked_system_transaction(HISTORY_STORAGE_ADDRESS) second.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-36, Trust Boundary: tb-004. Incorrect ordering causes stale history data.

checklist_item.title: Are transactions processed in sequential order within a block?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify apply_body processes transactions in block transaction list order.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-37, Trust Boundary: tb-006. Out-of-order processing causes consensus failure.

checklist_item.title: Are withdrawals processed after all transactions?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify apply_body calls process_withdrawals after all transactions.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-38, Trust Boundary: tb-007. Premature processing causes state root divergence.

checklist_item.title: Are general purpose requests processed last in block body?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify apply_body calls process_general_purpose_requests after withdrawals and transactions.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-39, Trust Boundary: tb-011. Incorrect ordering produces different requests_hash.

checklist_item.title: Are request types appended in correct order (deposits, withdrawals, consolidations)?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Craft transactions generating deposit logs, withdrawal requests, and consolidation requests. 2. Verify process_general_purpose_requests assembles in order: deposits, withdrawals, consolidations.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-40, Trust Boundary: tb-011. Request ordering determines requests_hash.

checklist_item.title: Are deposit requests parsed from block output logs (not system transactions)?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify deposit requests are derived via parse_deposit_requests from log entries.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-41, Trust Boundary: tb-011. Incorrect parsing could inject fraudulent validator deposits.

checklist_item.title: Are withdrawal and consolidation requests from checked system transactions?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Verify process_checked_system_transaction is called for withdrawal and consolidation request contracts.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-42, Trust Boundaries: tb-004, tb-011. Silent failures corrupt request data network-wide.

checklist_item.title: Are blocks with number < 1 rejected?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit block with header.number = 0 via P2P. 2. Verify validate_header rejects the block.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-43, Trust Boundary: tb-005. Block 0 could trigger unexpected code paths.

checklist_item.title: Are block timestamps strictly increasing?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit block with timestamp <= parent timestamp.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-44, Trust Boundary: tb-005. Non-increasing timestamps break time-dependent operations.

checklist_item.title: Are block numbers sequential (parent.number + 1)?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit block with number != parent.number + 1.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-45, Trust Boundary: tb-005. Non-sequential numbers break chain continuity.

checklist_item.title: Does parent_hash cryptographically match parent header?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Create block with parent_hash != keccak256(rlp.encode(parent_header)).
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-47, Trust Boundaries: tb-002, tb-005. Mismatch enables chain reorganization attacks.

checklist_item.title: Does excess_blob_gas match calculation from parent?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit block with incorrect excess_blob_gas.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-48, Trust Boundary: tb-005. Incorrect value affects blob fee calculations.

checklist_item.title: Is gas_used <= gas_limit enforced in header?
checklist_item.test_procedure: 1. Submit block with gas_used > gas_limit in header.
checklist_item.notes: Source: PROP-W0B17-49, Trust Boundary: tb-005. Exceeding limit breaks gas accounting model.
